question.text: Identify the method by which $\mathrm{Me}_{3} \mathrm{COOH}$ can be prepared.

options.text: Treating 1 mole of MeCOMe with 2 moles of MeMgI
Treating 1 mole of MeCO $_{2}$ Me with 3 moles of MeMgl
Treating 1 mole of MeCHO with 3 moles of MeMgl
Treating 1 mole of dry ice with 1 mol of $\mathrm{Me}_{3} \mathrm{CMgl}$
